_doc: Where the game client keeps a form's name under another key. prefixAliases: a species whose forms are named under another species' keys (form_vivillon_<pattern> names Scatterbug and Spewpa; form_burmy_<cloak> names Wormadam; form_core_<color> names Minior). regionalHeaders: a regional form takes the Pokédex header the game shows for it (alola_pokedex_header = "Alolan Form").
